correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts the two center states. With the center black, nonfull blades self-clear exactly at the relevant local threshold and full blades can only be cleared by the center, reducing the obstruction to fm<=ell. With the center white, the first force criterion is w_i+1<=ell, after which the center-black analysis applies. The polynomial and minimum formulas are direct counts of the resulting exact cases. Independent exhaustive simulation agrees with the criterion and formulas for all 81 triples 2<=r,m<=4 and 1<=ell<=rm.

value.rationale: Generalized windmills are a standard repeated-block family with a universal articulation, and k-forcing is a natural propagation invariant. The theorem identifies the exact phase changes at ell=m and at multiples of m, determines every forcing set rather than only the optimum, and gives closed polynomial and basis-count formulas. This is a reusable benchmark for propagation on clique bouquets and is more informative than a routine recomputation of one scalar value.
